method.shared_text: Pocket TTS runs entirely on this Android phone using the original floating point model.

observations.samples_A_and_C: unintelligible mumbling, with perhaps only the word 'Android' recognizable

A.revealed_route: fallback-disabled QNN-only observed neural path; FP source graphs mapped by HTP to FP16

C.revealed_route: fallback-disabled QNN-only observed neural path; calibrated INT16 FlowLM plus FP-source encoder/decoder mapped to FP16

interpretation: Technical QNN-only execution and valid WAV structure do not imply acceptable speech quality.
The 0012 derived CPU ONNX artifact is itself perceptually unusable, so matching its numerical tensors, EOS, or frame count is not a useful product-quality target.
No candidate from this blind set is recommended for deployment.
